project: Comedy Fantasy Card Game — First 4 Avatars
honest_summary: Nothing is PRODUCTION_READY. Pixel-cleanup t230 scripted a palette, speckle, outline, and hidden-region pass on the four avatar sprite layers and split each L01 into skin/face/hair/outfit. Cleaned sprites stay PROTOTYPE. Equipment PNGs were not recropped. Repairs are deterministic, not hand-painted.
